== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ヤヴィン4：作戦指令室</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja">リーダーがいて、この位置を支配していれば「アタック・ラン」の合計値に1を加えることができる。</span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja">ここを支配したなら、フォース消耗を＋1でき、「アタック・ラン」の合計から1を引くことができる。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Yavin 4: Briefing Room]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — The printed game-text box is blank.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
The printed title is 作戦指令室 (operations command room), not a literal briefing room. Dark uses できる (may) for Force drain +1 and subtracting 1 from Attack Run. Dark does not print here after Force drain.<ref>[[:File:ANH-L-yavin4briefingroom.gif|Original English face]], [[Yavin 4: Briefing Room]].</ref>
